# Glossary

## Bold terms

**API** - Application programming interface
**SLA** – service level agreement (en dash)
**SLO** — service level objective (em dash)
**RPO** --- recovery point objective, three dashes
**RTO**—no spaces around the em dash
**Term** - a bold header term is skipped
**Definition** — skipped too
**a**b** - term closes at the first double star
**x** --
**y** - 
**   ** - blank term
**API** - duplicate term, kept
  **Indented** - leading whitespace is stripped  
**NBSP** - non-breaking spaces around the dash
**US**-definition after unit separators
**Bold with *emphasis*** - it
**Cut** - bold line rejected | not | a table
* **Bullet** - a bullet is not a bold line
#hash - comment-like line skipped
